svg.text: Chapter 1 · Inside the Estimator's hut, on the map of the change process
improve the estimator, then rehearse again
The estimator learns its prices from
Each version is checked on them,
Three so far: v0.1, v0.2 and v0.3.
Newer bid results, piling up online
Left alone until there is a product
and someone who wants the answer.
The error bands we quote come only from here.
The rehearsal marks flatter us a little. The castle is where the numbers we quote come from.
